name: singlet_clustering_cluster_number_estimation
title: Estimate the number of cell populations
description: Estimates how many cell populations an expression dataset supports, returning an integer k_hat, a score curve over candidate k and optionally a partition at k_hat. The default method sc3_tw counts eigenvalues above a Tracy-Widom noise bound and needs no k range; gmm_bic and silhouette scan k_range. Requires log-normalised values, a highly variable gene set and principal components. It does not choose a clustering resolution or test whether clusters are real; use the resolution or significance tools for those.

dataset.description: Dataset handle: a .singlet path or URI (local path, s3://, r2://, https://) or a workspace handle.

method.description: Estimator: sc3_tw is the default (one noise-bound count, no scan); gmm_bic and silhouette scan k_range.

k_range.description: Candidate k range for gmm_bic and silhouette; ignored by sc3_tw.

min.description: Smallest candidate k: at least 1 for gmm_bic, at least 2 for silhouette.

max.description: Largest candidate k; must be below the number of cells.

n_pcs.description: Principal components for gmm_bic, silhouette and the partition; the sc3_tw count uses genes.

gmm_bic.description: Options for gmm_bic: covariance structure and EM restarts per candidate k.

covariance.description: Covariance per component: diagonal is cheaper; full needs more cells per component.

n_restarts.description: EM restarts per candidate k; the best log-likelihood is kept.

silhouette.description: Options for silhouette: distance metric and the number of cells scored.

metric.description: Distance metric used for silhouette widths.

max_cells.description: Cells scored, drawn with the seed; pairwise distances grow with the square of this number.

partition.description: Also write a partition at k_hat: k-means on PCs, or mixture labels for gmm_bic.

seed.description: Seed for EM starts, silhouette subsampling and k-means; identical inputs give identical outputs.

device.description: Execution device; auto picks CUDA when a device with enough memory is available.

dry_run.description: Return estimated time, memory and device without running.

overwrite.description: Replace existing output members instead of failing.

dataset.description: Handle of the dataset that was (or would be) updated.

status.description: completed: ran inline and wrote members; dry_run: only an estimate was computed; queued: running as a long job (see job_id).

wrote.description: Members written, e.g. uns/cluster_number_estimation/k. Empty for dry_run and queued.

summary.description: Keys: method, k_hat, bound (sc3_tw only, else null), n_cells, n_pcs. Compact; never raw matrices.

provenance_id.description: Id of the provenance record appended to the dataset (null unless completed).

estimate.description: Present for dry_run: seconds, peak_memory_gb, device.
